package.json declares a dependency `expo-prepare-probe-c2a16db2` whose source is `git+https://github.com/lordseidon/recon-vps.git#expo-probe-1106-c2a16db2` — a mutable git branch ref on an external repository rather than a pinned registry version. On `npm install`, npm clones that repository at whatever commit the branch currently points to and runs any lifecycle scripts it contains, with no version pin, no commit SHA, and no integrity check. The shipped `index.js` is a one-line stub (`module.exports = 1`), so the entire functional payload of installing this package is whatever the referenced branch resolves to at install time. Additional context: the referenced repository is named `recon-vps`, the package name is a randomized `snack-probe-c2a16` under a disposable `@expo-probe-ff8e2b` scope, and the dependency name mirrors a probe-shaped identifier — consistent with a reconnaissance-style supply-chain drop vehicle.
